descricao_original: Fetal blood in carried from the fetus to the placenta via two umbilical arteries in the umbilical cord. This blood is primarily deoxygenated blood that is high in wastes. A single umbilical vein returns oxygenated blood, high in nutrients, from the placenta to the fetus. The vessels are surrounded by mucous connective tissue, a multipotential fetal connective tissue. 10x
